zh-CN.title: 桌面上的友间
items: 桌面安装图标改用不透明浅色底，避免出现黑色背景
安装提示与桌面应用名称统一为 Frienden 友间，不再附带空间名

en.title: Frienden on your desktop
items: Desktop installation now uses opaque light-background icons instead of transparent artwork
Install prompts and app names consistently use Frienden 友间 without a space name
